description: Designed to sit between a customer’s network and security tools, the NTO 7303 is a solution that controls the flow of network traffic to destination security devices and applications. The module uses a pool of high-speed data interfaces that are intended to forward different classes of traffic based on filters applied to each interface.
allowed_algorithms: NDRNG; RSA (key transport; key establishment methodology provides 112 bits of encryption strength)
